# SAMS Mobile — SAMS IS-04Z1

> SAMS Mobile is a UK-registered company developing the SAMS IS-04Z1, an intrinsically safe Android 16 smartphone designed for Zone 1/21 and Zone 2/22 hazardous areas. The device is pre-launch (Q4 2026). IECEx, ATEX and NEC 500 certification is in progress; no certificate has been issued yet. SAMS does not claim any customer, distributor or operator relationship.

Key facts: IP68; 4,000 mAh battery; 50 MP camera; Android 16 with Android Enterprise; Qualcomm Snapdragon; 4G LTE; managed from existing MDM consoles. Contact: info@sams-mobile.com.

## Product and company

- [Industries](https://sams-mobile.com/industries/): Which hazardous-area zones, gas groups and dusts apply in oil and gas, petrochemicals, mining, pharma, power and ports, and what an Ex phone must handle.

## Guides
- [ADNOC Supplier Registration & ICV Certificate Guide](https://sams-mobile.com/insights/adnoc-supplier-registration-icv-guide/): ADNOC supplier registration and the ICV certificate explained for equipment suppliers: Supplier Hub, prequalification, ICV audits and how scores are used.
- [How to Verify an IECEx or ATEX Certificate (Checklist)](https://sams-mobile.com/insights/ex-equipment-documents-to-demand-from-a-supplier/): How to verify an IECEx or ATEX certificate and the full document set to demand from an Ex equipment supplier: schedule, declarations, conditions of use.
- [Intrinsically Safe vs Explosion Proof vs Flameproof](https://sams-mobile.com/insights/explosion-proof-vs-intrinsically-safe-vs-flameproof/): Intrinsically safe vs explosion proof vs flameproof: what each protection concept means, where it is allowed, and why a Zone 1 phone is intrinsically safe.
- [Hazardous Area Zones 0, 1, 2 vs Divisions Explained](https://sams-mobile.com/insights/hazardous-area-zones-and-divisions/): Hazardous area zones 0, 1 and 2 (and 20, 21, 22) against Class I Division 1 and 2: how areas are classified and what it means for the devices you carry.
- [How to Choose an Intrinsically Safe Smartphone (2026)](https://sams-mobile.com/insights/how-to-specify-an-intrinsically-safe-smartphone/): How to choose an intrinsically safe smartphone: a tender-ready checklist covering zone, gas group, temperature class, ingress, battery, MDM and documents.
- [ATEX vs IECEx vs NEC 500: Which Certificate You Need](https://sams-mobile.com/insights/iecex-vs-atex-vs-nec-500/): ATEX vs IECEx vs NEC 500: what each system covers, where they stop recognising each other, how to read a marking string, and which one your site needs.
- [KOC Vendor Registration: KOC, KNPC & KIPIC Guide](https://sams-mobile.com/insights/koc-knpc-kipic-supplier-registration-kuwait/): KOC vendor registration for equipment suppliers, plus KNPC and the former KIPIC assets at Al-Zour: portals, prequalification and documents for Ex gear.
- [JSRS Oman Registration for PDO & OQ Suppliers](https://sams-mobile.com/insights/oman-jsrs-supplier-registration-pdo-oq/): JSRS registration in Oman: how the Joint Supplier Registration System works for PDO and OQ, what it costs, how long it takes and what Ex suppliers need.
- [QatarEnergy Vendor Registration Guide (Mushtaryat)](https://sams-mobile.com/insights/qatarenergy-vendor-registration-guide/): QatarEnergy vendor registration for equipment suppliers: the Mushtaryat portal, SAP vendor code, Tawteen ICV scoring and the hazardous-area dossier.
- [Saudi Aramco Vendor Registration for Ex Equipment](https://sams-mobile.com/insights/saudi-aramco-supplier-registration-atex-equipment/): Saudi Aramco vendor registration for Ex and hazardous-area equipment: the Ariba e-Marketplace, prequalification, 9COM materials and the documents needed.
